_help: Whistle's default mappings: Herdr's own commands only. An update replaces this file; put yours in ~/.config/herdr-app/whistle.json ({ "enabled", "hints", "keys", "map" }), which goes over these and over the layout's "mappings" prop. A key set to null removes it.
map: key -> [label, command] or [label, command, {args}], or a group {name, map} whose keys follow (w v).
Commands keep you in WHISTLE; a 4th item "type" ends in TYPE instead: [label, command, null, "type"].
Keys: the character typed (p, /, +, ?) or a key name (space, enter, tab), with ctrl-/alt-/super- in front as in keys.json (ctrl-n). Groups nest.
A mapped key wins over whistle's own keys (below) and the keys a field handles itself, so leave those free.
command: any `herdr-app commands` name; name:value fills its first argument, as in keys.json.

whistle.field:<block> selects the field in that layout block; whistle.focus:<block> shows the block and selects it; whistle.toggle:<block> shows it or takes it away; whistle.settings opens whistle's settings.

keys: whistle's own keys in WHISTLE, action -> list of keys: field-left/down/up/right pick the field in that direction, left/down/up/right move inside it, open opens (in a terminal: back to typing there), type goes back to TYPE, cancel ends a key sequence, back goes up one level. A list in whistle.json replaces the default one; null removes the action.

keys.json runs before whistle sees a key, so whistle claims every ctrl-/alt-/super- chord in keys or map, and any other of their keys a global or layout section binds, in keys.json's mod:whistle section ("<key>": "whistle.key-<key>"); your own entries there stay and win.
Entering and leaving WHISTLE are regular keys.json keys: whistle.whistle (switches), whistle.enter (only enters), whistle.type (only leaves).
